### `content.microcopy` — Microcopy Author

Writes button labels, field labels and helper text that state outcomes in the product's voice.

**Why it exists.** “Submit” and “OK” are the default because good labels take thought nobody budgets for.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `transform` — Replaces the component's text in place; a provenance badge allows reverting. |
| Binds to | `Button`, `Link`, `Input` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |
| `context` | string | no |
| `voice` | string | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | string |
| `rationale` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.button("Save changes").ai("content.microcopy")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("content.microcopy", {"text": "Submit", "context": "saving profile settings"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "text": "Save changes",
  "rationale": "Names the outcome instead of the mechanism."
}
```

### `content.translate` — Scene Translation

Translates interface text into a target locale, preserving placeholders, names and formatting.

**Why it exists.** Localisation is usually a release blocker; it should be a property of the interface.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `transform` — Replaces the component's text in place; a provenance badge allows reverting. |
| Binds to | `Page`, `Shell`, `Text`, `Button` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `texts` | list of string | yes |
| `locale` | string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `texts` | list of string |
| `locale` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.page("Quarterly review").ai("content.translate")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("content.translate", {"texts": ["Save changes", "Welcome", "Hello {name}"], "locale": "es"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "texts": [
    "Guardar cambios",
    "Bienvenido",
    "[es] Hélló {name}"
  ],
  "locale": "es"
}
```

### `content.summarize` — TL;DR Summaries

Condenses long content into a short summary with key points.

**Why it exists.** Readers decide in seconds whether to read on; a faithful summary respects that.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `annotate` — An insight panel attached to the component, with confidence and provenance. |
| Binds to | `Text`, `Markdown`, `Card`, `Thread` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |
| `sentences` | integer | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | string |
| `body` | string |
| `bullets` | list of string |
| `confidence` | number |
| `tone` | one of `neutral`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`, `ai` |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.text("Se\u00f1or \u03a9 \u2713 \u2014 \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e \ud83d\ude80").ai("content.summarize")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("content.summarize", {"text": "The importer now accepts CSV and Excel files up to 50 MB. We decided to ship column mapping first and defer deduplication to the next rel…"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "title": "The importer now accepts CSV and Excel files",
  "body": "The importer now accepts CSV and Excel files up to 50 MB. Early testers reported that validation errors were confusing, so the error mess…",
  "bullets": [
    "We decided to ship column mapping first and defer deduplication to the next release",
    "Mira will write the migration guide by Friday"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.6,
  "tone": "ai"
}
```

### `content.tour` — Onboarding Tour Author

Writes a guided tour for a screen: which elements to introduce, in what order, with one sentence each.

**Why it exists.** Product tours go stale the moment the UI changes; generating them from the scene keeps them true.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `annotate` — An insight panel attached to the component, with confidence and provenance. |
| Binds to | `Tour` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | yes |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scene` | any | no |
| `audience` | string | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `steps` | list of object {target, title, body} |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.tour().ai("content.tour")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("content.tour", {"scene": {"type": "Page", "props": {"title": "Orders"}, "children": [{"type": "Search", "id": "q", "props": {"…": "1 keys"}}, {"type": "Table", "id": "orders", "props": {"…": "2 keys"}}]}})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "steps": [
    {
      "target": "q",
      "title": "q",
      "body": "Find anything here. Press the shortcut to jump straight in."
    },
    {
      "target": "orders",
      "title": "Table",
      "body": "Every record lives here. Click a header to sort, or filter in plain language."
    }
  ]
}
```

### `content.help` — Contextual Help

Writes the helper text or tooltip for any control: why it is asked and what a good answer looks like.

**Why it exists.** People abandon forms at fields whose purpose they do not understand.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `ask` — A popover answers questions about the element or screen. |
| Binds to | `Input`, `Select`, `Toggle` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | yes |
| `kind` | string | no |
| `context` | string | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | string |
| `body` | string |
| `bullets` | list of string |
| `confidence` | number |
| `tone` | one of `neutral`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`, `ai` |

ui.input("email").ai("content.help")

result = ctx.ai("content.help", {"label": "Work email", "kind": "input"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```

### `content.whats_new` — What's-New from Scene Diff

Writes a “what changed” note by comparing two versions of a screen.

**Why it exists.** Changelogs are written for releases; people need them per screen, at the moment they return.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | hybrid: the engine computes the facts, the model writes the narrative |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `annotate` — An insight panel attached to the component, with confidence and provenance. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `before` | any | yes |
| `after` | any | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | string |
| `body` | string |
| `bullets` | list of string |
| `confidence` | number |
| `tone` | one of `neutral`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`, `ai` |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.text("Se\u00f1or \u03a9 \u2713 \u2014 \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e \ud83d\ude80").ai("content.whats_new")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("content.whats_new", {"before": {"type": "Page", "props": {"title": "Orders"}, "children": [{"type": "Table", "id": "t", "props": {"…": "1 keys"}}]}, "after": {"type": "Page", "props": {"title": "Orders"}, "children": [{"type": "Search", "id": "q", "props": {"…": "1 keys"}}, {"type": "Table", "id": "t", "props": {"…": "1 keys"}}]}})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json

  "title": "What's new",

  "confidence": 0.9,
  "tone": "info"
}
```

### `content.notify` — Notification Triage

Rewrites notifications to be scannable, ranks them by urgency and decides which may interrupt.

**Why it exists.** Every notification competes for the same attention; most should wait.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `service` — Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | list of string | yes |
| `busy` | boolean | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `items` | list of object {index, priority, deliver, rewrite} |

**Use it**

```python
# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("content.notify", {"items": ["Payment failed for Globex — card declined", "Weekly digest is ready", "@you Mira commented on the Q3 plan"], "busy": True})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "index": 0,
      "priority": "high",
      "deliver": "now",
      "rewrite": "Payment failed for Globex — card declined"
    },
    {
      "index": 2,
      "priority": "medium",
      "deliver": "defer",
      "rewrite": "@you Mira commented on the Q3 plan"
    },
    {
      "index": 1,
      "priority": "low",
      "deliver": "defer",
      "rewrite": "Weekly digest is ready"
    }
  ]
}
```

### `content.truncate` — Semantic Truncation

Shortens text to fit a space by meaning — abbreviating and dropping filler — instead of cutting mid-thought.

**Why it exists.** An ellipsis hides the one word that mattered.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `transform` — Replaces the component's text in place; a provenance badge allows reverting. |
| Binds to | `Text`, `Heading`, `Badge`, `Tab` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |
| `max` | integer | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | string |
| `rationale` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.text("Se\u00f1or \u03a9 \u2713 \u2014 \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e \ud83d\ude80").ai("content.truncate")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("content.truncate", {"text": "Quarterly Revenue Report for the International Sales Department (draft)", "max": 34})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "text": "Quarterly Revenue Report Intl…",
  "rationale": "Dropped asides and filler before cutting; key nouns kept."
}
```

### `content.consent` — Consent Simplifier

Explains consent and legal text in plain words and flags the clauses people usually miss.

**Why it exists.** Consent nobody understands is not consent.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `annotate` — An insight panel attached to the component, with confidence and provenance. |
| Binds to | `Checkbox`, `Text`, `Markdown` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | string |
| `body` | string |
| `bullets` | list of string |
| `confidence` | number |
| `tone` | one of `neutral`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`, `ai` |

**Use it**
